lines.text: The Lord covers the Daughter of Zion with the cloud of His anger and swallows up the dwellings of Jacob without pity.
Like an enemy, the Lord has drawn His sword and poured out His wrath like fire on the tent of the Daughter of Zion.
Zion's king and princes are exiled among the nations, and her elders sit on the ground in silence wearing sackcloth.
Children and infants faint in the streets of the city, crying to their mothers, "Where are the soldiers?"

wrong_details.true: Where is the grain and wine

lines.text: The people are told to let their tears run like a river day and night, and to lift up their hands for their children.
